summary: Transforms a world-space position a2 into the object-local frame using the object position and rotation matrix, then appends an 88-byte entry (transformed vector plus four metadata fields) to a ring buffer, post-incrementing the write index. Vehicle physics constraint point batching.

operations.description: Compute append target as buffer base at this+0x240 plus 88 times the post-incremented write index at this+0x23C.
delta.x = a2[0] minus object position X at this+0x4.
delta.y = a2[1] minus object position Y at this+0xC.
delta.z = a2[2] minus object position Z at this+0x14.
Local-space X = delta dotted with rotation matrix row 0 (this+0x1C, this+0x34, this+0x4C); stored as first double of the entry.
Local-space Y = delta dotted with rotation matrix row 1 (this+0x24, this+0x3C, this+0x54); stored at entry offset 8.
Local-space Z = delta dotted with rotation matrix row 2 (this+0x2C, this+0x44, this+0x5C); stored at entry offset 16.
Store metadata dword a3 at entry offset 48 and metadata byte a4 at entry offset 52.
Store additional metadata dword a5 at entry offset 56 and metadata dword a6 at entry offset 60.
Return the pointer to the appended entry.
